notes.title: 2 Week Discount Sale!
notes.content:
Hello,

Today (4/11/2019) begins a two week sale of Why Chicken? Why?.
For all those wishlister's that haven't given the game a try, now is your chance.
Also, coming in May will be some extra content added to the game in the form of 3 mini-games (separate from the main game). Please be sure to leave a review if you end up purchasing the game. The May update will also feature some new achievements and extra goodies. Thanks for stopping by! #Feathers4Life
